definitions.explanation: Medication used to relieve or reduce pain. A general medical term covering both over-the-counter and prescription pain relievers.

examples.japanese: {鎮痛薬|ちんつうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{鎮痛薬|ちんつうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I have a bad headache, so please give me some painkillers.

examples.japanese: {鎮痛薬|ちんつうやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飲|の}みすぎ→飲みすぎ：22059_nomisugi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Taking too many painkillers puts a strain on the stomach, so caution is needed.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{鎮痛|ちんつう}→鎮痛：14515_chintsuu⟧ (pain relief) and {薬|やく} (medicine). This is the standard medical/formal term for painkillers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鎮痛薬|ちんつうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}する→服用する：21605_fukuyousuru⟧: to take painkillers (formal)
- {鎮痛薬|ちんつうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to prescribe painkillers
- ⟦{市販|しはん}→市販：12424_shihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鎮痛薬|ちんつうやく}: over-the-counter painkillers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鎮痛剤|ちんつうざい}→鎮痛剤：15451_chintsuuzai⟧: painkiller — virtually synonymous; ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ and {薬|やく} are interchangeable here
- ⟦{痛|いた}み{止|ど}め→痛み止め：23497_itamidome⟧: painkiller — the everyday, colloquial term most commonly used in conversation

USAGE:
In casual speech, ⟦{痛|いた}み{止|ど}め→痛み止め：23497_itamidome⟧ is far more common. {鎮痛薬|ちんつうやく} tends to appear in medical contexts, product packaging, and written materials.
